name: Transcribe speech
description: Turns spoken audio at a content reference (a voice note, an uploaded recording, raw 16 kHz PCM) into text. Reads the audio with the caller's own authority; a caller that already holds the audio, such as an app recording a microphone, gives it inline as base64 bytes with its mediaType instead, and nothing is stored. Returns {text, language?, seconds?, model, engine, ms}; silence returns no text. Anything that is not audio returns {}, so this operation serves unchanged as a Telegram or WhatsApp agent binding's mediaOperation. A transcript may mishear names and numbers.

ref.description: Content reference of the audio, such as an attachment's ref or dlfs/<drive>/<file>; at most 20 MiB. Give this or bytes.

bytes.description: The audio itself, base64-encoded, at most 20 MiB decoded; needs mediaType. Give this or ref.

mediaType.description: The audio's media type when the reference does not carry one, and always with bytes, such as audio/ogg, audio/mpeg or audio/wav. Raw PCM is audio/L16 (16-bit little-endian mono).

kind.description: A messaging attachment's kind; anything but audio or voice returns {}.

sampleRate.description: Sample rate of raw PCM input; defaults to 16000.

language.description: The spoken language as an ISO-639-1 code, such as en, when known; improves accuracy and speed.

prompt.description: Optional text to guide spelling and style, such as names or terms likely to be said.

model.description: Transcription model; defaults to the venue's configured model.

apiKey.description: Optional s/NAME reference to the caller's own key; by default the operator's key, else the caller's s/OPENAI_API_KEY, else none.
